name: TabStops2
remarks: Tab stops are indexed numerically from left to right along the ruler.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the TabStops2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that represents the Microsoft Office application in which the TabStops2 object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets an Object that represents the Parent object of the specified TabStops2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the TabStops2 collection. Read-only.

properties.name: DefaultSpacing
properties.description: Gets or sets the default spacing between tab stops. Read/write.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Gets an individual object from the TabStops2 collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The number of the object to return.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Type As MsoTabStopType, Position As Single) As TabStop2
methods.description: Adds a new tab stop to the specified TabStops2 object.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of tab stop to add.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: The horizontal position of the new tab stop relative to the left edge of the text frame. Numeric values are evaluated in points; strings are evaluated in the units specified and can be in any measurement unit supported by the Microsoft Office product.
